title: Great experience
content: Although not easy to get appointment Probably  very challenging if your not online Once I had spoken to Gp invited for face to face consultation I was seen and physically examined  Felt like I was listened to by empathic GP Didn’t feel like  I was  being a nuisance even though it was late on Friday afternoon I expect after a long week Tests arranged and called back  one week later and hospital outpatient appointment arranged I feel there is a great deal of criticism of the NHS currently and feel that it is important to give positive feedback when appropriate In a previous professional capacity I worked in NHS and had exposure to many doctors I would like to praise the GPs professionalism and efficiency and say thankyou
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
